sub_answers.sub_question: What provisions related to provincial powers are contained in Sri Lanka's Thirteenth Amendment to the Constitution?
sub_answers.text: The Thirteenth Amendment provides for devolution of power to the provinces and established a new system of provincial government through the Provincial Councils Act No 42 of 1987 [d81740317s2p0]. The amendment enabled the merger of the Northern and Eastern provinces subject to a later referendum [d225283s3p0]. The amendment granted official status for the Tamil language as part of concessions to Tamil demands [d225283s3p0].

Other Tamil militant groups that were active in advocating for Tamil political aims included the Tamil Eelam Liberation Organization (TELO), People's Liberation Organisation of Tamil Eelam (PLOTE), Eelam Revolutionary Organisation of Students (EROS), Eelam People's Revolutionary Liberation Front (EPRLF) and Tamil Eelam Liberation Army (TELA) [d225283s3p0]. Indian political actors and the Indian state of Tamil Nadu strongly supported Tamil demands and India negotiated devolution measures in the Indo-Sri Lanka Accord [d225283s3p0].

sub_answers.sub_question: What formal legal authorities, gazette notifications, national or provincial policy documents, official reconstruction or recovery plans and named government programmes governed rebuilding and land/settlement decisions in the Northern Province (cite laws, decrees, policy plans and the issuing institutions)?
